title: CGRP pathway in migraine pathogenesis
abstract: Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) plays a key role in migraine pathogenesis by mediating trigeminovascular nociceptive transmission. Antagonists blocking CGRP or its receptor are highly effective therapeutics.

title: Serotonin 5-HT1B/1D receptors in cranial vasoconstriction
abstract: Triptans act as selective agonists at 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptors to induce cranial vasoconstriction and inhibit pro-inflammatory neuropeptide release from trigeminal nerves.
